reason: A multi-platform collection of agent skills primarily focused on developing, packaging, integrating, and maintaining plugins, agents, hooks, commands, MCP servers, and related workflows, with additional writing, frontend, documentation, and external-service tools.

summaries.zh: 面向多种智能体平台的技能集合，主要用于开发、打包、集成和维护插件、智能体、Hook、命令及 MCP 等工具，并附带写作、前端和文档相关技能。
summaries.en: A multi-platform agent skill collection focused on developing, packaging, integrating, and maintaining plugins, agents, hooks, commands, and MCP tools, with additional writing, frontend, and documentation skills.

capabilities: Provides agent skills for creating and reviewing plugins, agents, hooks, commands, MCP integrations, and workflows
Supports terminal and CLI-oriented development tasks including Git operations and pull request workflows
Integrates with external documentation, MCP, Cloudflare email, and multiple agent platforms
Includes writing, frontend design, project instruction, semantic linting, and conversation-history retrieval skills
